hindi: पृथ्वी पर तीन रत्न हैं: जल, अन्न, सुभाषित। मूढ़ों द्वारा पत्थर के टुकड़ों में रत्न नाम दिया जाता है।
english: On earth there are three jewels: water, food, the well-spoken word. By fools the name 'jewel' is applied to pieces of stone.

words.gloss: of the tree of one's own fault

hindi: अपने अपराध के वृक्ष के ये फल देहधारियों के हैं: दरिद्रता, दुःख, रोग, बन्धन और विपत्तियाँ।
english: These are the fruits of the tree of one's own fault, of embodied beings: poverty, sorrow, diseases, bondage and calamities.

hindi: धन फिर, मित्र फिर, पत्नी फिर, पृथ्वी फिर; यह सब फिर प्राप्त किया जा सकता है, शरीर बार-बार नहीं।
english: Wealth again, friend again, wife again, earth again: all this can be obtained again; not the body, again and again.
lines_deva: एतत्सर्वं पुनर्लभ्यं न शरीरं पुनः पुनः
lines_iast: etatsarvaṃ punarlabhyaṃ na śarīraṃ punaḥ punaḥ

hindi: और बहुत-से प्राणियों का मेल निश्चय ही शत्रुओं को जीतने वाला है; वर्षा की धाराओं को धारण करने वाला मेघ तिनकों से भी रोका जाता है।
english: And indeed, the union of many beings is enemy-conquering; the cloud that bears streams of rain is warded off even by straws.
notes: ca eva rendered 'and indeed'; ca has no coordinate partner in the verse. ripuñjaya taken as an adjective 'enemy-conquering'.

words.gloss: from the power of the thing

hindi: जल में तेल, खल में गुप्त बात, पात्र में दान, बुद्धिमान में शास्त्र, थोड़ा भी, अपने आप वस्तु की शक्ति से विस्तार को जाता है।
english: Oil in water, a secret in the base, a gift in a worthy recipient, a treatise in a wise man, even a little, goes by itself to expansion through the power of the thing.
notes: manāk api stands after dānam but is taken with the whole list; the singular verb yāti serves all four subjects.
lines_deva: जले तैलं खले गुह्यं पात्रे दानं मनागपि
प्राज्ञे शास्त्रं स्वयं याति विस्तारं वस्तुशक्तितः
lines_iast: jale tailaṃ khale guhyaṃ pātre dānaṃ manāgapi
prājñe śāstraṃ svayaṃ yāti vistāraṃ vastuśaktitaḥ

hindi: धर्म के कथन में और श्मशान में रोगियों की जो बुद्धि हो, वह यदि सदा ही बनी रहे, कौन बन्धन से मुक्त न हो जाए?
english: The mind that may come to be in the exposition of dharma and in the cremation ground, of the sick: if that should remain always indeed, who would not be freed from bondage?
notes: rogiṇām matiḥ is taken as 'the mind of the sick', a third occasion alongside the two locatives; ca follows śmaśāne only.
lines_deva: धर्माख्याने श्मशाने च रोगिणां या मतिर्भवेत्
सा सर्वदैव तिष्ठेच्चेत्को न मुच्येत बन्धनात्
lines_iast: dharmākhyāne śmaśāne ca rogiṇāṃ yā matirbhavet
sā sarvadaiva tiṣṭheccetko na mucyeta bandhanāt

words.gloss: of one in whom remorse has arisen

hindi: जिसे पश्चात्ताप उत्पन्न हुआ है, उसकी बुद्धि जैसी होती है, वैसी यदि पहले हो, तो किसका महान् उदय न हो?
english: The understanding that comes to one in whom remorse has arisen, of whatever kind it is: if such were there before, for whom would there not be a great rise?
lines_deva: तादृशी यदि पूर्वं स्यात्कस्य न स्यान्महोदयः
lines_iast: tādṛśī yadi pūrvaṃ syātkasya na syānmahodayaḥ

hindi: दान में, तप में, शौर्य में अथवा विज्ञान में, विनय में, नीति में निश्चय ही आश्चर्य नहीं करना चाहिए; पृथ्वी बहुत रत्नों वाली है।
english: In giving, in austerity, in valour or in knowledge, in humility, in policy, wonder is indeed not to be felt; the earth is rich in jewels.
notes: vismayaḥ kartavyaḥ is idiomatic 'one should feel wonder'. vinaya could also be 'discipline'; vijñāna also 'discernment'.
lines_deva: दाने तपसि शौर्ये वा विज्ञाने विनये नये
lines_iast: dāne tapasi śaurye vā vijñāne vinaye naye

hindi: दूर स्थित भी दूर स्थित नहीं है, जो किसी के मन में स्थित है; जो किसी के हृदय में नहीं है, समीप स्थित भी दूर है।
english: Even one standing far off is not standing far off, who is placed in someone's mind; who is not in someone's heart, even standing near, is far away.
lines_deva: दूरस्थोऽपि न दूरस्थो यो यस्य मनसि स्थितः
यो यस्य हृदये नास्ति समीपस्थोऽपि दूरतः
lines_iast: dūrastho'pi na dūrastho yo yasya manasi sthitaḥ
yo yasya hṛdaye nāsti samīpastho'pi dūrataḥ

hindi: और जिससे प्रिय की इच्छा करे, उससे सदा प्रिय बोले। शिकारी मृगों का वध करने के लिए मधुर स्वर में गीत गाता है।
english: And from whom one should wish for what is pleasing, to him one should always speak what is pleasing. A hunter, to carry out the killing of deer, sings a song sweet-voiced.
notes: tu is weak here and left untranslated. tasya brūyāt: genitive of the person addressed, rendered 'to him'. susvaram may also be an adjective agreeing with gītam ('a sweet-toned song'); the adverbial reading is taken here.
lines_deva: व्याधो मृगवधं कर्तुं गीतं गायति सुस्वरम्
lines_iast: vyādho mṛgavadhaṃ kartuṃ gītaṃ gāyati susvaram

hindi: अत्यन्त समीप, विनाश के लिए; दूर स्थित, फल देने वाली नहीं। मध्य भाव से सेवित हों राजा, अग्नि, गुरु, स्त्रियाँ।
english: Too near, for destruction; standing far, not fruit-giving. Let king, fire, teacher, women be served with a middle feeling.
notes: The feminine āsannā, dūrasthā, phalapradā in line a have no expressed subject; they agree with an implied feminine noun that the line does not state. madhya-bhāva = a middle attitude, i.e. moderation.

hindi: अग्नि, जल, स्त्रियाँ, मूर्ख, सर्प और राजकुल, छह, सदा यत्न से सेवा के योग्य हैं, तुरन्त प्राण हर लेने वाले।
english: Fire, waters, women, fools, snakes and royal families, six, are to be served always with care, life-taking at once.
lines_deva: अग्निरापः स्त्रियो मूर्खाः सर्पा राजकुलानि च
नित्यं यत्नेन सेव्यानि सद्यः प्राणहराणि षट्
lines_iast: agnirāpaḥ striyo mūrkhāḥ sarpā rājakulāni ca
nityaṃ yatnena sevyāni sadyaḥ prāṇaharāṇi ṣaṭ

words.gloss: of one devoid of virtue and dharma

hindi: वह जीता है जिसके गुण हैं, जिसका धर्म है वह जीता है। गुण और धर्म से हीन का जीवन निष्प्रयोजन है।
english: He lives whose are virtues; he lives whose is dharma. Of one devoid of virtue and dharma, life is purposeless.
lines_deva: स जीवति गुणा यस्य यस्य धर्मः स जीवति
lines_iast: sa jīvati guṇā yasya yasya dharmaḥ sa jīvati

hindi: यदि तुम एक कर्म से जगत् को वश में करना चाहते हो, पहले पन्द्रह मुखों से चरती हुई गाय को रोको।
english: If you wish to bring the world under control by one action, first restrain the grazing cow from fifteen mouths.

text_flags.why: possible: the accusative feminine singular is expected, agreeing with gām; final m looks missing

notes: gām = cow; gau also means speech, earth, sense-organ, but no alternative is applied. The word 'fifteen mouths' is translated literally with no explanation. carantī in the text is flagged as a possible missing final m. nivāraya with the ablative = restrain from.

hindi: जो अवसर के अनुरूप वाक्य, प्रभाव के अनुरूप प्रिय, अपनी शक्ति के समान क्रोध को जानता है, वह पण्डित है।
english: He who knows speech suited to the occasion, the dear suited to influence, anger equal to his own power, he is a learned man.
notes: priyam is neuter 'what is dear/pleasing'; the exact sense (kindness, affection) is not specified by the line.
lines_deva: आत्मशक्तिसमं कोपं यो जानाति स पण्डितः
lines_iast: ātmaśaktisamaṃ kopaṃ yo jānāti sa paṇḍitaḥ

hindi: एक ही वस्तु तीन प्रकार से देखी जाती है: शव, कामिनी स्त्री, मांस, योगियों द्वारा, कामियों द्वारा, कुत्तों द्वारा।
english: One single thing is seen in three ways: a corpse, a woman given to desire, flesh, by yogins, by the desirous, by dogs.
notes: tu is weak here and left untranslated. The pairing of nouns with the instrumentals follows the order of the Sanskrit; 'respectively' is not printed.
lines_deva: एक एव पदार्थस्तु त्रिधा भवति वीक्षितः
कुणपं कामिनी मांसं योगिभिः कामिभिः श्वभिः
lines_iast: eka eva padārthastu tridhā bhavati vīkṣitaḥ
kuṇapaṃ kāminī māṃsaṃ yogibhiḥ kāmibhiḥ śvabhiḥ

hindi: भली-भाँति सिद्ध औषध, धर्म, घर का दोष और मैथुन, बुरा खाया हुआ, और निश्चय ही बुरा सुना हुआ, मतिमान् प्रकट न करे।
english: A well-prepared medicine, dharma, a fault of the house and sexual union, what was badly eaten, and indeed what was badly heard, a man of understanding should not make known.
notes: gṛhacchidra: the doubled c comes from sandhi of gṛha + chidra. kubhukta and kuśruta are taken as neuter 'what was badly eaten / badly heard'.

hindi: कोयलों द्वारा और निश्चय ही दिन तब तक मौन में बिताए जाते हैं, जब तक सब लोगों को आनन्द देने वाली वाणी प्रवृत्त नहीं होती।
english: Days are passed in silence by cuckoos, and indeed,, until speech giving joy to all people goes forth.
notes: tāvat ... yāvat with a present verb is taken as 'up to the time that / until'; the Hindi uses the idiomatic negative. ca eva is rendered 'and indeed'; ca has no coordinate partner.

hindi: धर्म, धन और धान्य, और गुरु का वचन, औषध: भली-भाँति ग्रहण किया हुआ और करने योग्य; अन्यथा वह जीता नहीं।
english: Dharma, wealth and grain, and the teacher's word, medicine: well grasped and to be done; otherwise he does not live.
notes: The construction of sugṛhītaṃ ca kartavyam is compressed; it may also mean 'is to be made well held'. tu is weak and left untranslated; the subject of jīvati is not expressed.
lines_deva: धर्मं धनं च धान्यं च गुरोर्वचनमौषधम्
सुगृहीतं च कर्तव्यमन्यथा तु न जीवति
lines_iast: dharmaṃ dhanaṃ ca dhānyaṃ ca gurorvacanamauṣadham
sugṛhītaṃ ca kartavyamanyathā tu na jīvati

hindi: दुर्जनों का संसर्ग छोड़ो, साधुओं के समागम का आश्रय लो; रात-दिन पुण्य करो, अनित्यता के कारण सदा स्मरण करो।
english: Abandon association with wicked men, resort to the company of the good. Do merit day and night, remember always, because of impermanence.
notes: nityam anityataḥ is ambiguous: 'always, because of impermanence' (taken here) or 'the permanent, as distinct from the impermanent'.
